name: Cursor Video Grid
description: Responsive grid of video cards with a custom circular cursor that shows play or pause on hover. Click toggles playback, one video plays at a time, with a progress bar.
contents: Video cards with category tag, title, hint text and play/pause button
Custom circular cursor following the pointer
behavior: Click a card to play or pause, starting one pauses the others
Cursor circle scales in on card hover and swaps play and pause icons
Thin progress bar tracks playback, live dot pulses while playing
One column on mobile, two columns from large screens
editableByProps: Videos, titles, categories, hint and label text
Cursor and progress bar color, active card border color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the focus ring and live dot colors
needsCodeEdit.where: ring-emerald-400 class on the card div
lg:grid-cols-2 class on the grid div

fixed: Adds a window pointermove listener for the custom cursor and removes it on unmount
Native cursor is hidden over the videos, so the custom cursor is needed
Cursor is pointer-driven and has no effect on touch, where tapping a card still toggles playback
